import pandas as pd

# File paths for all source tables
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/training_6.csv"
]

# Corresponding target column suffixes for SalePrice columns from each source
# According to target schema:
# Source 0 -> SalePrice_x
# Source 1 -> SalePrice_y
# Source 2 -> SalePrice_x_3
# Source 3 -> SalePrice_y_4
# Source 4 -> SalePrice_x_5
# Source 5 -> SalePrice_y_6
# Source 6 -> SalePrice (final SalePrice column in target)
saleprice_columns = [
    "SalePrice_x",
    "SalePrice_y",
    "SalePrice_x_3",
    "SalePrice_y_4",
    "SalePrice_x_5",
    "SalePrice_y_6",
    "SalePrice"
]

# Step 1: Load all source tables into dataframes with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Step 2: Rename the SalePrice column in each dataframe to the corresponding target column name
for i, df in enumerate(dfs):
    df.rename(columns={"SalePrice": saleprice_columns[i]}, inplace=True)

# Step 3: Join all dataframes on 'Id' column
# All source tables share the same schema ['Id', 'SalePrice'], so join on 'Id'
# Use successive merges to combine all dfs on 'Id'
# Start with the first dataframe
df_merged = dfs[0]
for df in dfs[1:]:
    df_merged = df_merged.merge(df, on="Id", how="inner")

# Step 4: Ensure the target schema columns order and types
# Target schema: ['Id': int, 'SalePrice_x': float, 'SalePrice_y': float, 'SalePrice_x_3': float,
#                 'SalePrice_y_4': float, 'SalePrice_x_5': float, 'SalePrice_y_6': float, 'SalePrice': float]

target_columns = [
    "Id",
    "SalePrice_x",
    "SalePrice_y",
    "SalePrice_x_3",
    "SalePrice_y_4",
    "SalePrice_x_5",
    "SalePrice_y_6",
    "SalePrice"
]

# Select and reorder columns
df_target = df_merged[target_columns].copy()

# Convert types explicitly
df_target["Id"] = df_target["Id"].astype(int)
for col in target_columns[1:]:
    df_target[col] = df_target[col].astype(float)

# Step 5: Save the resulting dataframe to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_7/target_multisource_cot.csv"
df_target.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
